description: This file defines APIs for objects to support Data Model Library, including function declarations for setting and getting parameter string and integer values related to MsgBusTest.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for MsgBusTest.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for MsgBusTest.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for MsgBusTest.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for MsgBusTest.
